category: other: no retreat after the button press - pressed the start button, then kept rubbing the top of the machine until timeout
what_happened: Scene: layout 9 (same kitchen and brown two-button machine as s0), blue mug_7 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasp 117/132 (rim), carried to the machine and set on the tray, released 338 at 0.0343 m from the pour site (0.0346 m 2 s later), upright; at target 311-1200. Stage 1: 384-444 the fingers went down the front face to the lower button; the machine registered on at 440 and stayed on. The gripper never backed off: 480-1200 it hovered over and rubbed the lid of the machine (touch 517-598, 681-839, 1119-1200). Stage 0 held only 609-619 (arm briefly > 25 cm from the mug). Success never held because the gripper was always within 15 cm of the button or 25 cm of the mug.
causal_chain: mug placed 0.034 m from the pour site (338) -> button pressed, machine on (440) -> gripper stays over the machine top 480-1200 -> 'gripper away from button and mug' clause never met -> timeout
self_recovery: none; after the press it kept moving over the machine as if still looking for the button.
official_criterion_notes: Both physical sub-goals were done by 440. Failure is only the gripper-away clause. first_incomplete_stage = 0 is an artifact of the 25 cm release clause (undone_events: 'only the release part broke').
